membership_started.subject: Welcome to {planName}
membership_started.heading: Your membership is confirmed
membership_started.body: Thank you for becoming a member with {planName}. Your included sessions and member benefits are in your account.

membership_renewal_reminder.subject: {variant, select, ends {Your {planName} membership ends soon} other {Your {planName} membership renews soon}}
membership_renewal_reminder.preheader: {variant, select, ends {Your membership ends in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.} other {Your membership renews in {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.}}
membership_renewal_reminder.heading: {variant, select, ends {Your membership ends soon} other {Your membership renews soon}}
membership_renewal_reminder.body: {variant, select, ends {You cancelled {planName} at the end of the current period. You keep all member benefits until then.} other {Your {planName} membership continues automatically for another period. You can cancel at the end of the period in your account.}}

membership_renewed.subject: Your {planName} membership has been renewed
membership_renewed.preheader: Thank you, your payment was received.
membership_renewed.heading: Your membership has been renewed
membership_renewed.body: Thank you, we received your payment for {planName}. The sessions included in this period are in your account.
membership_renewed.late: Your membership is active again from today.

membership_payment_failed.subject: Payment of your {planName} membership failed
membership_payment_failed.preheader: Pay your renewal to keep your membership.
membership_payment_failed.heading: We could not collect your payment
membership_payment_failed.body: {attempt, select, 1 {The payment for the renewal of {planName} did not go through.} other {Your renewal of {planName} is still unpaid.}} Pay it with the link below to keep your membership.
membership_payment_failed.deadline: Without payment, your membership ends on {date}.
membership_payment_failed.keeps_access: Until then you keep your member benefits.

membership_expired.subject: Your {planName} membership has ended
membership_expired.heading: Your membership has ended
membership_expired.body: The renewal of {planName} was not paid, so your membership has ended. You are welcome back any time with a new membership.

membership_cancel_confirmed.subject: Your {planName} membership has been cancelled
membership_cancel_confirmed.heading: Your cancellation is confirmed
membership_cancel_confirmed.body: No further payments will be taken for {planName}. Changed your mind? You can resume your membership in your account before it ends.
